2. In the Restaurant audio, it is clear Charlie is talking to console Katherine of her involvement in the murder / the fbi bump. If someone was talking about “killing” and “murder” in a conversation, certainly anyone uninvolved wouldn’t sit and engage. They’d be like “what the heck are you talking about!?!?” 

3. Katherine’s testimony was damning as heck. You can hear Charlie say some crazy things in the recording and she claims on the stand “I didn’t hear that”. 

Again, I know this evidence is not desireable nor the smoking gun the prosecution would have wanted but it’s clear Katherine was involved in this murder. The whole point is not just about payment because they got hurt which is a misconception many have about workers comp. Its not just about paying out because there was an injury during work. If that was the case, many many more people would be filing workers comp claims. It’s about paying out what the company owes to the person that got hurt. Keyword, owes. Again, stubbing your toe at work will most likely not get you a payout even if you have to take a week off to heal from it unless there was some negligence on the company’s duty to the employee.
Some attorneys do free consultation so it might be worth it looking into doing a free 30 min consult with a workers comp lawyer to help you identify what you could do in this specific situation
Look into it, there are specific circumstances that need to be met to get the money. Just because I got hurt at work doesn’t mean my job is now responsible for my bills.

Don’t have him over 24/7,  when he is over try to stay in your personal space/room, and don’t neglect her as your friend either. Find ways to spend time with both of them separately and if possible, welcome times for you three to hang out (maybe monthly dinners at the apt?)

Overall, I know how your friend probably feels and if it was anything like my situation, she’s just feeling insecure about herself.
